intro: Eden creates a bedroom that is your place of comfort, calm, and effortless organisation. It brings timeless design and smart functionality together—so you can unwind in style and ultimate comfort. Plush comfort or firm support - the Restomagic Dual let's you choose. The dual-sided mattress allows for with two firmness levels, so whatever your needs, you wake up rested and ready for the day.

features.title: Ledged headboard for display
features.text: The ledged headboard keeps books, décor, and essentials within arm’s reach, so you can stay organised without sacrificing style.

features.title: Pull-out and box storage for easy access
features.text: Maximise your space with a combination of pull-out and box storage—store frequently used items in the pull-out section, while the box storage keeps larger essentials neatly organised.

features.title: Cushioned headboard for comfort
features.text: The cushioned headboard provides plush support, letting you relax with a book, watch your favorite show, or enjoy a peaceful moment before sleep.

features.title: Sturdy metal under structure
features.text: Built to last, the durable metal frame ensures long-term stability and strength, supporting your comfort with unwavering reliability.

features.title: Comfort on both sides, your way
features.text: Crave flexibility? Our dual-sided mattress lets you pick between plush comfort and firm support—so your bed adjusts to you.

features.title: Soft quilting adds an extra layer of comfort
features.text: Your bed should welcome you the moment you lie down, and our plush quilted top does exactly that, offering soft, breathable comfort that helps you unwind with ease.

name: Eden V2 King Size Engineered Wood Pullout Storage Bed And Mattress Combo
